parole.testo: According to Petrounias inherited from Koine Greek καρῶτα (karôta), a feminine noun conceived as neuter plural, a repatriated term from Latin carota, from Koine Greek καρωτόν (karōtón). According to Babiniotis, who spells it etymologically καρώτο (karóto), a repatriated term from Italian carota conc
